v0.21 removes SledStorage, its Cargo feature, and the CLI's Sled backend. To move an existing Sled database to Redb, first export it with the **v0.20 CLI**. Then load the dump into a new database with the **v0.21 CLI**. [Sled removal (#2066)](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/2066)
GlueSQL v0.21 adds two storage backends. **SlateDB** lets applications store tables in an Amazon S3 or Cloudflare R2 bucket and update them in SQL transactions. The **SQLite** backend stores GlueSQL tables in a local databa

This release contains breaking API and storage-format changes. Read the upgrade notes before updating an existing application or database.
`SledStorage` is deprecated in v0.20.0 and is planned for removal in v0.21.0 ([#2013](https://github.com/gluesql/gluesql/pull/2013)). Existing deployments can continue using it during the v0.20 release cycle, but new persistent deployments should use `RedbStorage`.
GlueSQL v0.20.0 makes the Rust core synchronous, introduces `StatementPlan` and a typed query execution pip

    gluesql::params![1_i64, "Alice"],
).await?;

// SELECT with parameter
let rows = glue
    .execute_with_params(
        "SELECT name FROM users WHERE id = $1",
        glues
